comparisons.peer_summary: Assets invested in managed accounts and J.P. Morgan mutual funds where AWM is the investment manager are included in asset management metrics, with further details available in the AWM segment results.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures address definitions and scope within asset management metrics. Morgan Stanley defines 'Outflows' in its AUM rollforward by specifying what is included (redemptions, transitions) and excluded (exchanges within the same asset class). J.P. Morgan similarly defines the scope of assets included in its asset management metrics, specifying that it includes assets invested in managed accounts and mutual funds where AWM is the investment manager. While MS focuses on the liability side (outflows) of the rollforward and JPM focuses on the asset inclusion criteria for reporting metrics, both serve to clarify the specific components that constitute the reported asset management figures.
